description: Zenviq builds AI-powered voice receptionists for dental clinics, GP practices, and therapy offices. Our bots answer inbound calls 24/7, handle FAQs, book appointments, and take messages — so your staff can focus entirely on patient care.

product.name: Zenviq Call Bot
product.what_it_does: An AI voice receptionist that answers your clinic's phone calls. It greets patients, answers common questions, books and manages appointments, and handles after-hours calls — all with a natural, conversational voice.
key_features: Clinic FAQ answering (hours, location, services, insurance)
Natural voice powered by advanced AI
Works on your existing phone number via Twilio

starter.includes: 1 bot, up to 500 calls per month, standard voice, email support

growth.includes: Up to 3 bots for different niches, up to 2000 calls per month, premium voice, priority support

enterprise.includes: Unlimited bots, custom integrations, dedicated account manager, SLA guarantee

pricing.trial: We offer a 14-day free trial for new practices

how_to_book_demo: Collect the caller's name, email address, type of practice (dental, GP, therapy, etc.), and their preferred day/time for a demo call. Confirm the details and let them know the Zenviq team will reach out within 24 hours to schedule.

faq.q: Does it really understand natural speech?
faq.a: Yes. Zenviq uses state-of-the-art speech recognition and large language models — the same technology behind tools like ChatGPT — so it understands natural, conversational speech, including accents and medical terminology.

faq.q: What happens if a patient asks something the bot can't answer?
faq.a: The bot politely lets the patient know it will take a message or transfer the call to a human. No patient is left without a next step.

faq.q: Can it book directly into our existing system?
faq.a: We currently offer mock booking for the demo. Live integrations with Google Calendar and popular clinic management systems are coming in Q3 2026.
We are building toward HIPAA compliance. For the demo phase, no protected health information is stored. Full compliance documentation will be available before the enterprise launch.
For most practices, the bot is live within 1-2 business days. We handle the Twilio and LiveKit configuration for you.
